title: feat: FightClub 5e XML export (FR4.5)
body:
Adds a "Export FC5 XML" button to the wizard's Review step that downloads a FightClub 5e-compatible `.xml` character file. Export is available regardless of validation state; unmapped fields (alignment, personality traits) emit as empty/default values.

## New: `FightClub5eExporter` (`CharacterWizard.Shared/Export/`)
- Takes the same seed data lists as validators (races, classes, backgrounds, spells, equipment)
- Produces a `<document><character>…</character></document>` XML string with UTF-8 declaration
- Derived stats: HP (max die per level × class count), proficiency bonus, initiative, AC (unarmored), passive perception
- `<save>` elements sourced from `ClassDefinition.SavingThrows`, deduped across multiclass entries
- `<skillprof name="…">` from `Character.Skills`, `<item>` uses `EquipmentItemDefinition.DisplayName`, `<spell>` includes full spell details
- `<race>` uses subrace display name when present (e.g. "Hill Dwarf" not "Dwarf (Hill Dwarf)")

## Model change
- `RaceDefinition` gains `Speed` property (`int`, default 30) — already present in `data/races.json` and `race.schema.json`, just missing from the C# model

## Wizard UI
- "Export FC5 XML" button added alongside "Export JSON" and "Print Sheet" on the Review step
- Calls `CommitAllToCharacter()` then triggers `downloadFile` JS interop with `application/xml` MIME type

## Tests
20 new tests in `FightClub5eExporterTests` covering: single-class, multiclass class string, saving throw dedup, skill proficiencies, spell level/school/components, equipment display names, empty optional fields, proficiency bonus at levels 1 and 5, HP formula (single and multiclass), speed from race, subrace display name, and passive perception with/without proficiency.
